fields.value: Team Lead with 11.8 years of IT experience in application development, enhancement, maintenance, service delivery. Designed and developed N-tire web, windows using C#, ASP.NET core, MVC, API, Angular as front end and securing using JWT token and SQL Server. Good understanding of Architecture concepts like SOLID principles, Design patterns and Microservices. Proficient in SQL Server, with hands-on experience in developing stored procedures, triggers, and views, executing database backup and recovery, creating scheduled jobs, performing database migrations, and implementing SSIS solutions. Worked extensively with Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory (ADF) pipelines, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Microsoft Power BI (Power BI Desktop) to develop cloud-based integration, data processing, and reporting solutions. Working knowledge of Azure DevOps and familiar with Kubernetes and Docker. Experience working across the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance, within Agile Scrum environments. Working knowledge of IT service management (ITSM) and issue-tracking tools, including Remedy, ServiceNow, Cherwell, and Jira. Capable of managing projects end-to-end, from requirements gathering and solution design to implementation and delivery.
